Bengal Ministers Urged to Focus on Work, New Policy Planned

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has instructed ministers to concentrate on their work rather than being "hyperactive on the street." This directive comes as two ministers, Agnimitra Paul (Municipal Affairs) and Sharadwat Mukherjee (Health), have been observed visiting streets and hospitals. Separately, the West Bengal government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Adani Enterprises to explore cultural initiatives related to Durga Puja. Additionally, a new industrial policy for Bengal is expected to be introduced before Durga Puja, according to Minister Suvendu Adhikari.
